column1: # News feed list for the local news box — approved ("approved, start building the poller").
# Personal only (indexhost). poller.py reads this file; add or remove a line and redeploy search-news.
# URLs are the outlets' published feed addresses as known when drafted; a feed that keeps
# failing is disabled by the poller (see its log), never retried hard.
# lean = a rough placement for balance only (left | lean-left | center | lean-right | right | -), from widely
# cited media-bias charts; spot-check it. poll = target minutes between conditional GETs (adaptive later).
# --- Wire services and CNN: no public RSS, but each publishes a Google News sitemap (XML: every article of the
#     last ~48 h with headline and time) for search engines. kind news-sitemap = parse <url><news:news>;
#     kind sitemap-discover = read the site's robots.txt for its news sitemap (AP's exact path is not known).
#     robots.txt is honoured: a sitemap it disallows is skipped.
# --- Substack and independent newsletters (every Substack publication has /feed). Hand-picked for a
#     left/right spread; feed URLs as known, unverified.
